about: One judgment row (ggwp_obs_states; view pick_obs.states). Trends: identity x geo, window_kind H or D. GSC: identity x
country (or ALL) x window 24h or 7d. GSC state is the primary formal label, or present when no label passed its formal bar;
labels lists every hit, formal or descriptive, with its condition and counts. A descriptive row (admission descriptive) has
no formal hit. A Trends row is stale only when carried over. Unobserved counts are null, never 0 (premise 1).
The data page and the agent read these rows only (design 7.1).
